jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview:

**Job Title:** Senior Business Analyst

**Work Location:** Hyderabad, India (Hybrid Mode)

**Job Description**

**Summary**

Senior Business Analysts will be responsible for leading and implementing technical solutions to business problems, or to advance a company’s efforts, begins with defining, analysing and documenting requirements. This role shall also be managing internal and external stakeholders and expectations. Managing requirements at the project level can help fulfil business needs. To succeed in this role, you should have a natural analytical way of thinking, a broad picture of the problem statement, its impact and its user space and a good understanding of our internal and external stakeholders and drive towards the best successful outcome for both.

To be successful in this role you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and ability.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Manage and collaborate with client stakeholders
* Manage and collaborate with internal stakeholders
* Understand business and technical need of the requirements.
* Capture the requirements and prioritize them along with the respective stakeholders.
* Break the requirements into smaller tasks or stories based on necessity.
* Prepare the requirement traceability matrix and maintain it.
* Create user story documents with reference to the traceability matrix created.
* Capture the acceptance for all the requirements.
* Work on gap analysis between two versions of guiding Care for client upgrades.
* First point of contact for all the requirement related clarifications.
* Validate all the requirements with respect to the story documentation signed off by the stakeholders.
* Demonstrate features and help the stakeholders to stay abreast with the features of the product.
* Participate in daily scrums, sprint planning meetings, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Participate in daily meetings with product managers, SMEs, and other stakeholders extracting requirements.
* Work as a liaison between the stakeholders/clients and scrum team.
* Analyse customer workflows and convert them into system workflows.
* Communicates status externally and raising risk at the right time.
* Support new client implementations.
* Manage Product Backlog.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

Senior Business Analyst is not a supervisory role. You will receive general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new projects or assignments.

**Education Qualification**

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Administration

4-7 years of related experience.

Certification - ECBA, CCBA, CBDA, AHM-250 and CBAP is preferred.

**Competencies**

* Agile Business Analysis
* Excellent communicator with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Highly proficient technical writing capabilities
* Presentation skills
* Technical Knowledge
* Analytical Skills
* Negotiation Skills

jobs.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
Content & Technology Solutions (CTS) is the industry leading content delivery platform. Clients seamlessly access organized and connected content that is easily discoverable, explorable, and procured via the Open:FactSet Marketplace. Data is delivered via a variety of technologies and formats that meet the needs of our client's workflows. By enabling our clients to utilize their preferred choice of industry standard databases, programming languages, and data visualization tools, we empower them to focus on the core competencies needed to drive their business. The Strategic Business Unit has experienced a double-digit year-over-year growth rate. Our solutions portfolio includes Standard DataFeeds, Data Exploration, OnDemand (API), Views, Cornerstone, Benchmark Feeds, and the Open: FactSet Marketplace.

Knowledge of data and technology workflows and end users common in the financial industry is a plus.

**Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development.**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead**
to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks.

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails.

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

* Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems.
* Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns.
* Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards.
* Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements.
* Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform.

2. AI Application Development

* Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation.
* Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes.
* Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems.
* Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows.
* Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components.

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

* Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models.
* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies.
* Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases.
* Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider.

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

* Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs.
* Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules.
* Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP.
* Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance.
* Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership.

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

* Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs.
* Design human-approval workflows where required.
* Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability.
* Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models.
* Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements.

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

* Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions.
* Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs).
* Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines.

Mandatory Technical Skills

**Agentic AI & Generative AI**

* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures.
* Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation.
* Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability.

**Programming & Application Development**

* Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node.js/TypeScript.
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration.

**AI Frameworks & SDKs**

* Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs.
* Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology.

**LLM Integration**

* Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs.

**Data Engineering & RAG**

* Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search.

* Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture.

jobs.description:

**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.

* 2 years of experience in software development or engineering.

**About The Job**
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Java with Cloud - AWS
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled **Senior Software Engineer with strong Java expertise** **and cloud experience** to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will design and build scalable web services, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to delivering robust, high-performance software solutions leveraging modern technologies and cloud platforms.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable and high-performance web services using Java
* Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate web services seamlessly into web applications
* Implement RESTful APIs to enable smooth communication between client-side and server-side applications
* Ensure robustness, reliability, and security of web services by applying best practices and standards
* Optimize web services for performance and scalability, considering factors like caching, load balancing, and database optimization
* Work closely with cross-functional teams including product managers, architects, and QA engineers to deliver high-quality software solutions
* Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring adherence to coding standards
* Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in Java development and web services

**Requirements**

* 6-8 years of IT experience, with a minimum of 6 years of strong proficiency in Java
* Understanding of web services development, including RESTful APIs
* Background in frameworks such as Spring Boot for building and deploying web services
* Expertise in implementing security best practices, including authentication and authorization using Spring Security and JWT
* Familiarity with SQL queries and stored procedures, as well as ORM frameworks like Hibernate for database interaction
* Proficiency in Linux commands
* Knowledge of web security principles and best practices
* Skills in version control systems such as Git and ADO
* Working knowledge of Azure DevOps (Sprint board, PR, Jenkins, Docker & Kubernetes, etc.)
* Capability to leverage Swing, AWT, JavaFX, and Java Desktop Applications
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

**Nice to have**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Knowledge of Angular
* Experience with microservices architecture
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
* Knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes
* Background in Agile development methodologies, with certification in Java programming or related technologies

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer - Node.js + GraphQL
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled **Lead Node.js Developer** to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications and enterprise-grade solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in modern **JavaScript**, **TypeScript**, **Node.js**, and cloud technologies, with a strong understanding of frontend architecture, backend services, application security, performance optimization, and software design principles.

As a Lead Developer, you will play a key role in designing technical solutions, mentoring team members, driving architectural decisions, implementing best practices, and delivering high-quality, secure, and maintainable applications.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain server-side applications using Node.js and NestJS, writing reusable, testable, scalable, and efficient backend code
* Design and implement RESTful APIs and GraphQL APIs for frontend services and third-party integrations
* Build secure authentication and authorization systems using JWT and role-based access control
* Integrate external services, APIs, and cloud-based solutions, while implementing logging, monitoring, caching, and error-handling mechanisms
* Optimize API performance and troubleshoot bottlenecks to ensure high availability and responsiveness
* Design and maintain database schemas and data models, working extensively with SQL and NoSQL databases
* Optimize database queries and indexing strategies to ensure data integrity, scalability, and high-performance data access
* Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS, leveraging AWS services for hosting, storage, monitoring, and scalability
* Participate in CI/CD pipeline implementation and deployment automation, monitoring application performance and troubleshooting production issues
* Write comprehensive unit tests, ensure high test coverage, conduct code reviews, and enforce development best practices using tools such as ESLint and SonarQube
* Apply frontend and backend security best practices to prevent and mitigate Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF/XSRF), and CORS vulnerabilities, including secure JWT token management and authentication workflows
* Design scalable and maintainable software architectures applying SOLID principles and design patterns such as Singleton Pattern, mentor junior and mid-level developers, and collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Managers, Designers, QA Engineers, and DevOps teams

**Requirements**

* 8+ years of professional software development experience
* Proven experience building large-scale applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js
* Expertise in GraphQL for API design and development
* Background in application architecture and performance optimization
* Skills in testing and cloud deployments
* English proficiency at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced **Solution Architect - Azure with AI** to lead the design and delivery of scalable, AI-driven solutions within the Azure ecosystem. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise, strong leadership skills, and a passion for building innovative GenAI platforms that align with business goals and long-term architecture strategy.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Provide end-to-end technical leadership from solution design to implementation, ensuring alignment with business goals and long-term architecture strategy
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers and stakeholders to refine user stories and translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions
* Design and develop architecture blueprints, including system design, integration strategies, and solution components for GenAI platforms
* Lead the development and deployment of RAG-based applications, AI automation solutions, and intelligent interfaces within the Azure ecosystem
* Define and implement best practices for performance, scalability, security, and cost optimization across AI and cloud solutions
* Guide and mentor engineering teams, ensuring high-quality code, adherence to standards, and effective delivery
* Drive integration with enterprise systems using APIs, Microsoft Graph, and other external services
* Contribute to technical decision-making, risk assessment, and mitigation strategies while ensuring successful delivery of complex AI solutions

**Requirements**

* 12-16 years of experience in software engineering
* Expertise in designing and building scalable applications on Azure cloud using Azure Functions, Web Apps, API Management and Azure DevOps
* Hands-on experience with Generative AI solutions including Azure OpenAI, prompt engineering and implementation of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) using Azure AI Search
* Background in building and integrating AI-driven applications such as chatbots, automation workflows and NLP-based systems
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Bicep or ARM templates along with strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
* Solid programming skills in Python or C#/.NET with exposure to frameworks like FastAPI or Web APIs
* Competency in designing unstructured data pipelines including data ingestion, transformation, enrichment and indexing for AI-driven applications
* Understanding of distributed system design, scalability, performance optimization and monitoring using Azure Application Insights
* Familiarity with agentic frameworks, orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel) or multi-agent systems

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Kubernetes or container-based deployments (AKS)
* Exposure to multi-region deployments and high-availability architecture
* Familiarity with SonarCloud or similar code quality tools
* Background in product-based or platform engineering environments

jobs.title: Scrum Master
jobs.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
The Scrum Master is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for guiding and coaching teams in the use of Scrum / Agile practices.  
  
The primary responsibility of this role is to boost the effectiveness of teams by managing key projects, championing cross team alignment and delivering success and operationalizing underlying processes to make development teams hum effectively.  
  
The Scrum Masters resolves impediments, monitors and has control over the scrum processes and meetings.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Fosters a self-organizing and empowered environment that enables teams to deliver high-quality products on time and within budget.
* Facilitates and leads Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensures that teams adhere to the Scrum framework, follows agile best practices, and utilizes appropriate tools and metrics to track progress, identifies bottlenecks, and drives continuous improvement.
* Fosters effective communication and collaboration between cross-functional teams, product owners, and stakeholders.
* Acts as a bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring a shared understanding of the project goals, priorities, and timelines.
* Proactively addresses any conflicts or challenges that may hinder team performance and delivery.
* Collaboratively identifies and synchronizes project interdependencies across multiple teams. Facilitates effective resource allocation across the programs.
* Drives the continuous improvement of agile processes, methodologies, and tools across the organization. Identifies and implements process enhancements to optimize efficiency, productivity, and quality of deliverables.
* Encourages innovation to foster a culture of continuous leading and growth.
* Ensures the program benefits remain viable throughout the program, communicating status and date changes and actively manage dependencies.
* Builds strong relationships with key stakeholders and manages these expectations regarding project scope, timelines, and deliverables.
* Collaborates closely with product owners to prioritize backlog items and ensures alignment with business goals.
* Provides regular project status updates and communicates any risks or impediments that may impact project success.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Ability to recognize the importance of working through others within the team through engaging and empowering others to use as much of their own capabilities as possible, thereby fostering trust and high energy to succeed.
* Has drive and energy to get the job done.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Assertive with the ability to come up with solutions to critical situations.
* Ability to make timely decisions and take calculated risks.
* Seasoned knowledge of other Agile approaches such as XP, Kanban, Scrum, extreme Programming (XP).
* Seasoned knowledge of the technologies used by the team.
* Ability to coordinate large teams with cross-functional dependencies.
* Proactive and organized with the ability to work in a fast-paced, team environment providing consistent, high-quality output.
* Ability to facilitate discussions to allow the team to consider alternative solutions or approaches and bring disagreements out into the open to help to manage them collaboratively.
* Ability to stimulate and relish change, adapt quickly and see change as an opportunity.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Project Management or related field.
* Relevant certifications such as SAFe Scrum Master or SAFe Advanced Scrum Master preferred.
* Other related certifications and/or training (for example - SAFe DeVos, Implementing SAFe etc.).

**Required experience:**

* Seasoned Scrum Master experience in an ICT environment, managing software projects and working with software development teams.
* Seasoned experience in Scrum Management.
* Seasoned experience of Agile concepts and principles.
* Seasoned experience as a coach and mentor in agile practices (Scrum, Kanban etc.).
* Seasoned experience with contemporary software development methodologies.
* Seasoned experience with widely successful Agile techniques such as User Stories, ATDD, TDD, Continuous Integration, Continuous Testing, Pairing, Automated Testing, Agile Games.

**Workplace type****:**

Hybrid Working

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

jobs.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Product Specialist II**
An Applied AI Product Specialist II is a mid-level individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product’s value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross-functional product teams to solve customer problems that align with business needs. Being a mid-level product management role, you will have the opportunity to own products of lesser complexity that drive business value. The Applied AI Senior Product Specialist, like any of our product managers, is accountable for the product’s success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. This role harnesses AI and agentic tools to compress the concept-to-cash learning loop—automating analysis, prototyping, and compliance detail-work so the team can focus on the human judgment AI cannot replace: product sense-making.
  
  
The Applied AI Product Specialist II plays a crucial role in ensuring the success of our less complex yet valuable products by balancing customer needs with business objectives. This role requires a blend of strategic vision, analytical skills, and collaborative teamwork to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. It demands some experience in the modern product management craft and a drive for continuous improvement—amplified by the fluent, responsible use of AI to learn faster and earn faster.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**

* Product Accountability

+ Responsible and accountable for the product's value and viability showcasing a measurable Return on Investments (ROI)
+ Drive strategy-aligned solutions to achieve product value objectives.
+ Formulate and achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for identified problems to solve.
+ Measure KPIs and analyze outcomes to inform future strategies.
+ Leverage AI to harvest outcome evidence early and often, lowering total cost of ownership (TCO).

* Vision and Strategy

+ Co-create, own, and evangelize the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, using AI to deepen domain knowledge and simulate future scenarios to chart pathways others have not yet seen.
+ Align product objectives with the product line and business goals.
+ Co-create in collaboration with business stakeholders, engineering, experience, and delivery.

* Market and User Engagement

+ Conduct user research and competitive analysis, using AI agents to synthesize research at speed—accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
+ Engage the team with users and stakeholders through continuous research and direct interactions.
+ Collaborate and guide the team toward solutions that address priority user and business needs.

* Collaboration and Teamwork

+ Work side-by-side with cross-functional (business, engineering, experience, and delivery) team members to achieve KPI outcomes.
+ Promote a product operating model that emphasizes outcomes over output (minimize overproduction while maximizing value).
+ Build empowered teams and product communities who exhibit collective product ownership.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Remove obstacles for the team and ensure smooth flow of continuous value achievement.
+ Promote and drive rapid, emergent, and ongoing learning and adaptation to meet objectives.
+ Drive innovation and improvement of the process to drive out waste and accelerate value achievement, using AI as a force-multiplier to offload the repetitive, speed up the sluggish, and automate the mundane.
+ Spread knowledge and best practices within the product vertical community.

* Applied AI Ways of Working

+ Amplify innovation: use AI to rapidly deepen domain knowledge, surface untapped market and user potential, and simulate future scenarios—charting new pathways for the business rather than only collecting requirements.
+ Amplify learning: use AI agents to synthesize research and validate ideas before they enter the backlog—compressing lead time by accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
+ Amplify focus: act as Editor-in-Chief—using AI to rigorously test assumptions and retire ideas that do not genuinely serve the user’s workflow in a way that works for the business.
+ Amplify experimentation: use AI to build early, functional, disposable prototypes that validate the architecture and the solution, playing a key role in the Agentic Secure Software Development Life Cycle that paves a clear path for engineering to productionize.

**The successful candidate will possess:**

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

**The team**
Deloitte Product Engineering (PxE) is developing advanced, agentic AI-enabled solutions that are redefining the future of work across our organization and for global clients. We are committed to bringing together outstanding product, engineering, and design talent to lead this transformation.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
* 6+ years of proven experience in product management or related roles.
* 1+ years of building AI based intelligent products
* 1+ year’s experience in using GenAI tools to perform product management tasks like conduct idea research, shaping, synthesis, roadmaps, requirements, prototyping, testing
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
* Ability to travel 0-20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

* Hands-on background supporting production infrastructure
* Solid knowledge of CI/CD practices and tooling

jobs.description:
**About Target:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.

**About Team & Role:**

Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.

Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.

As a Director of Product Management, you will set the overall strategic vision for your product portfolio and lead the team in delivering measurable business outcomes. You will establish short- and long-term product goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and manage product budgets and financials.

The Director of Product Management based in India is a strategic product leader responsible for accelerating Service Centre product capabilities and AI adoption, strengthening execution rigour, prioritising investments, enabling operational efficiency, and providing leadership across Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams globally and locally.

Further the role will be responsible for

* Driving day-to-day product excellence and velocity of Cross-functional teams
* Ensuring strong alignment between global product strategy and local execution, especially faster decision making
* Elevating product thinking, maturity, innovation, and data-driven decision-making leveraging Digital-first mindset.
* Serving as the site leader for product team functionally reporting to the US product leader

**Detailed Job Description:**

Success in this role requires balancing strategic thinking with execution excellence, fostering strong product and engineering practices, and building high-performing teams. This leader will transform servicing data into actionable enterprise insights, accelerate digital adoption, reduce friction across customer journeys, and create scalable, reusable platforms that strengthen loyalty, improve productivity, and unlock enterprise value.

You will build, coach, and mentor a strong team of Product Managers while fostering a culture of progress, transparency, accountability, and efficiency. You will elevate the team’s performance by providing insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback and by partnering with senior leaders and peers across pyramids to resolve execution-related barriers.

You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, validating hypotheses and concepts with customers before committing engineering capacity. You will guide complex work across multiple pyramids and interrelated specialities. You will use data and analytics to assess market context, inform decisions, evaluate product health and effectiveness, understand P&L impact, and provide clear recommendations to key stakeholders.

You will possess or develop a strong understanding of servicing platforms and systems, including data flows, transaction sequences, relevant technologies, and design principles, to enable innovative and scalable solutions across Target.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of product management experience, including experience leading product teams, preferably within retail, consumer, or servicing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading product-driven business transformation.
* Experience managing product portfolios, investment priorities, budgets, financials, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology, data, analytics, and digital product development.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders across complex, cross-functional organisations.
* Expertise in establishing product vision, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, and success measures.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and lead high-performing product teams.
* Expertise in agile product-development practices, including iterative development, discovery, experimentation, and backlog management.

jobs.description:
**Description**
Join Amazon Health Services' One Medical team and shape the systems that determine how customer generated health data and third party health data drive better health outcomes for patients. You will define product strategy and drive execution for the platforms that ingest, normalize, and surface health data from diverse sources — wearables, connected devices, lab integrations, and patient reported inputs — turning fragmented signals into actionable clinical and consumer insights. These systems power experiences across the care continuum: enabling providers to make more informed decisions, helping patients engage meaningfully with their own health, and unlocking data driven personalization across Amazon Health Services.
  
  
Health data is unlike typical consumer data: it is governed by HIPAA and evolving state level privacy regulations, arrives in inconsistent formats (HL7, FHIR, proprietary device APIs), carries clinical significance that demands accuracy, and requires careful consent and access controls. Every product decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - Tech to own the product strategy for how One Medical ingests, reconciles, and leverages customer generated and third party health data to improve care delivery and patient outcomes. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across data ingestion pipelines, health record enrichment, data quality and normalization, and surfacing insights to clinicians and patients — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying data platforms and ML systems.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Define the product vision and multi year roadmap for customer generated health data systems: data ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and clinical surfacing
  
  
Translate complex health data and regulatory constraints (HIPAA, FHIR/HL7 interoperability, consent management, state privacy laws) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against
  
  
Design and own the end to end metrics framework for data quality, completeness, and clinical utility within your domain
  
  
Work with Clinical Operations, Provider Experience, Compliance, Privacy, and Platform Engineering partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
  
  
Partner with Applied Scientists and Engineers to define success criteria for data reconciliation models, insight generation algorithms, and automated triage systems
  
  
Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare
* Experience with ML/AI product management — defining success criteria for models, managing model lifecycle, A/B testing ML systems
* Master's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics

By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

* 10+ years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Experience managing and support Corporate Security systems such as C-Cure 9000 for access control, various video management software, crisis & continuity management and risks systems
* Experience of deploying cloud resources (Azure) to manage Security systems

* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Technical / Tools Proficiency**

* **SQL**: Advanced querying (joins, window functions, CTEs, performance tuning) across large relational/Teradata/Hive data warehouses.
* **Python**: Data wrangling (pandas/numpy), automation scripting, statistical analysis, and visualization (matplotlib/seaborn).
* **PySpark**: Distributed data processing for large campaign/transaction datasets, working within Hadoop/Spark ecosystems.
* **SAS**: Base SAS and SAS Macros for large-scale data manipulation, campaign tagging, and reporting automation.

**Domain Knowledge – Banking & Card Products**

* Solid grounding in consumer banking/credit card business fundamentals: account lifecycle, interest income, fees, credit risk basics, and portfolio economics.
* Understanding of the credit card marketing lifecycle: acquisition, activation, usage, retention, and attrition.

**Campaign Analytics & Measurement**

* Design and execution of test-vs-control and champion-challenger frameworks for campaign effectiveness.
* Incrementality/lift analysis, response modeling, and uplift measurement.
* Campaign performance tracking: response rates, conversion, activation, spend, and profitability metrics.
* Experience building recurring performance dashboards/scorecards for campaign monitoring and post-campaign readouts.

**Statistical & Quantitative Analysis**

* Hypothesis testing, A/B testing methodology, and significance testing.
* Segmentation and targeting analysis (behavioral, demographic, risk-based).
* Regression/predictive modeling exposure (logistic regression, decision trees) for propensity/response scoring is a plus.
* Data quality checks, reconciliation, and root-cause/variance analysis.

**GenAI / Emerging Tools Familiarity**

* Working knowledge of Generative AI tools for analytics productivity — e.g., using LLM-based assistants for code generation/debugging (SAS/SQL/Python), documentation, and summarization of campaign results.
* Exposure to prompt engineering basics for querying enterprise GenAI platforms (e.g., internal chat/assist tools) to accelerate exploratory analysis and reporting.
* Awareness of GenAI use cases in marketing analytics: automated insight generation, natural-language querying of datasets and synthetic test data creation.
* Curiosity/adaptability to continuously evaluate and adopt new AI-assisted analytics tools as the function modernizes its toolkit.

**Communication**

* Ability to translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations for marketing/product stakeholders.
* Strong storytelling with data — clear presentation of insights to senior stakeholders (PowerPoint/Excel proficiency).
* Cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, Risk, Finance, and Technology teams.
* Project management skills to manage multiple concurrent campaign analytics requests under tight timelines.

**Behavioral Attributes**

* Independent ownership of analytics workstreams with minimal supervision, commensurate with 5-7 years of hands-on experience.
* Mentoring junior analysts and reviewing their analytical output.
* Strong attention to detail and controls mindset given regulatory sensitivity of rate-based offers.
* Proactive problem-solving and ability to work in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Support, Supply Chain
jobs.description:
**Description**
We are seeking a highly analytical and business-savvy Business Analyst to join our Supply Chain SSD team. In this role, you will be the analytical engine behind decisions impacting SSD business, the tip of the speed spear.
  
  
You will partner closely with Program Managers, Operations, Supply Chain, and Tech teams to identify inefficiencies, surface insights from large and complex datasets, and translate them into actionable recommendations. The ideal candidate is someone who lives and breathes data, has strong SQL chops, can build dashboards that tell a story, and brings sharp business acumen to identify and solve hard, ambiguous problems. We are looking for a hands-on operator - someone who does not wait for clean data or perfect requirements, but rolls up their sleeves, digs into the problem, and drives it to closure.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
∙ Deep-dive analytics: Independently scope, design, and execute complex analyses on inventory placement, network flow, regional demand patterns, fill rates, and outbound shipping cost drivers. Translate raw data into clear, actionable business insights.
  
  
∙ Dashboard and reporting ownership: Build, automate, and maintain self-serve dashboards (QuickSight, Tableau, or similar) that give stakeholders real-time visibility into key placement, inventory health, and network performance metrics.
  
  
∙ SQL and data engineering: Write efficient, production-grade SQL on large datasets (Redshift, Hive, Athena). Build and maintain ETL pipelines, data marts, and reusable datasets that scale across the team.
  
  
∙ Problem identification: Proactively find gaps, anomalies, and improvement opportunities in placement logic, replenishment patterns, and inventory positioning — often before stakeholders ask. Frame these as business problems with quantified impact.
  
  
∙ Drive business decisions: Partner with Program Managers and Category teams to size opportunities, run A/B tests or controlled experiments, and recommend changes to placement strategy, sourcing policies, or network design.
  
  
∙ Goal and metric ownership: Own the definition, tracking, and reporting of team-level metrics and weekly/monthly business reviews (WBR/MBR). Investigate variances and root-cause performance misses.
  
  
∙ Stakeholder communication: Present findings to senior leadership in crisp, data-backed narratives — both written documents and verbal reviews. Influence decisions without authority.
  
  
∙ Tooling and automation: Identify manual, repetitive workflows and automate them using SQL, Python, or scripting. Continuously raise the bar on team productivity.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
* Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
* Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar

**Job Description**
Business Analyst Senior will work as a liaison among stakeholders to elicit, analyze, communicate, and validate requirements for changes to business processes, policies, and information systems. + Work with project team to prioritize requirements and agree on assumptions and constraints.
